description: A tall gray toy refrigerator is in front of a small play kitchen, with a pink bowl and a yellow cup sitting on the counter. The left hand pulls the refrigerator door open toward the left, then the right hand lifts the pink bowl off the counter and brings it forward; the right hand repeatedly pinches and drops small white cube “ice” pieces from the bowl into the gray dispenser pocket mounted on the inside of the open door while the left hand steadies the bowl, and finally the right hand returns the bowl to the counter and the left hand swings the refrigerator door shut.
